content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I am working with a [product_name] CPU [article_no] and an 8 I/O module, along with an [product_name] sensor module, but I’m unable to get readings from the sensor. I’ve tried using analog inputs 1-8, but it doesn't work. Could anyone assist me? I appreciate any support.
Could you clarify what exactly is happening?

I connected the sensor to the [product_name] sensor module but cannot get readings from the PT100 sensor. I’m using the analog input, along with an analog amplifier in series, but the readings are not coming through. I also tried switching between analog inputs 1-8, but that made no difference.
Hello. I was able to resolve the issue by switching the analog input after powering off the [product_name] CPU and then powering it back on. Thank you for your help.

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced issues integrating a PT100 sensor with a [product_name] CPU and its associated I/O and sensor modules. The main challenge involved recognizing analog input channels for correct sensor readings. The issue was resolved after restarting the hardware and reconfiguring the input, suggesting that hardware resets may be necessary for configuration changes to take effect. The discussion shows confusion during sensor setup and the importance of clear instructions for hardware integration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the PT100 sensor input to be recognized automatically, without needing troubleshooting or repeated hardware resets.
